# Veedu Veettumanai Santhai Pvt Ltd (VVMS)

> Leading Civil Engineering Due Diligence, Real Estate Advisory & Turnkey Construction firm headquartered in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. Founded by Chartered Civil Engineer Er. J. Vairavel. 125,000+ YouTube subscribers and 1,900+ on-site walkthroughs.

## Core Services & Portals
- [Promoter Representation & Real Estate Sales Solutions](https://imclass.co.in/business-solutions): Six end-to-end B2B solutions including sole selling mandates, digital buyer acquisition, AI lead qualification, accompanied site visits, 100+ broker distribution, and bank loan coordination.
- [Turnkey House Construction Packages](https://imclass.co.in/construction): Civil engineering construction rates per sqft in Trichy (Basic ₹1,950, Standard ₹2,250, Premium ₹2,650), structural warranties, and milestone payment schedules.
- [Civil Engineering Due Diligence Services](https://imclass.co.in/services): 11 specialized property advisory services including 30-year legal title opinions, on-site water & structural audits, and guideline valuations.
- [Market Intelligence & SRO Guideline Comps](https://imclass.co.in/intelligence): Ground-verified micro-market dossiers comparing registration guideline values with market rates across 8 Trichy corridors.
- [Verified Property Listings](https://imclass.co.in/properties): 100% DTCP and RERA approved residential plots, luxury duplex villas, and independent homes in Trichy.
- [Real Estate Due Diligence Academy](https://imclass.co.in/academy): Practical educational guides for Tamil home buyers to avoid unapproved layout traps and verify Patta/Chitta.
- [Free Legal & Construction Resources](https://imclass.co.in/resources): Downloadable due diligence checklists, sample BOQ templates, and guideline value tools.
- [About Founder Er. J. Vairavel](https://imclass.co.in/about): Background, civil engineering credentials, and company history.
- [Head Office & Consultation Booking](https://imclass.co.in/contact): In-person advisory appointments at Valli Tower, Olaiyur Ring Road, Trichy.
